## Intake Form (prototype)
Receives submissions from intake.html and emails the team.
New-client intake ahead of the discovery meeting: contact
info, teammates to CC, company + website + socials,
industry (for tagging), and the one main pain point —
typed, or recorded as a voice note (attached to the email
as an audio file), or both.

Recipients fixed (kavya@ + saanchi@).
